_comment: Applied by the wizard ONE SETTING AT A TIME from a single process (parallel setSetting calls clobber each other). Values are strings as Kodi stores them.

plugin.video.umbrella._why: TMDbHelper is the only Trakt scrobbler; Umbrella keeps watched/resume locally (these are its defaults - pinned in case they change).

plugin.video.fenlight._why: Fen Light stores settings in its own database, not settings.xml. Its defaults are already right: watched_indicators=0 (local), update.username=thejason40, update.location=thejason40.github.io. Nothing to apply.
